description: Figure 7 is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the average attention distribution across three categories—“Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other”—for two distinct model configurations labeled “Ours” and “Standard.” The horizontal axis represents the model configurations, with “Ours” positioned above “Standard.” The vertical axis represents the percentage of attention allocation, with a scale from 0% to 100%. The bar for “Ours” is segmented into three colored portions: a blue segment labeled “Context” accounting for 60.6%, an orange segment labeled “Generated Response” accounting for 31.7%, and a green segment labeled “Other” accounting for 7.7%. The bar for “Standard” is similarly segmented: a blue segment labeled “Context” accounting for 23.6%, an orange segment labeled “Generated Response” accounting for 51.1%, and a green segment labeled “Other” accounting for 25.3%. The chart’s legend, located below the bars, explicitly maps the colors to their respective categories. The bars are not sorted and are presented in a stacked format, with each bar’s total length representing 100% attention allocation.
